title: solutions-pro-services-weekly-sync-notes-2026-07-07
content:
Date: 2026-07-07
Meeting: Solutions Engineering + Professional Services Weekly Sync
Owner / Notes prepared by: Aisha Patel
Attendees: Aisha, Miguel, Emily, Jordan, Priya, Sam (SRE), QA: Lina (occasional)

Objective:
- Weekly status on active customer integrations, major blockers, rollout readiness, and prioritization for next week. Quick standups per customer followed by action items.

Standup summary (high level):
- AcmeHealth (priority beta) — Owner: Miguel
  - Status: Data pipelines stable in staging, inference integration complete, end-to-end tests passing 78% (intermittent failures around long-context sessions).
  - Blockers: Occasional KV-cache eviction causing 5-10s token latency spikes on tail requests; Sam opened a SRE ticket (PROJ-8424) to trace autoscaler interactions.
  - Risk/Notes: HIPAA review matched expectations but want final audit log format confirmed. Security needs KMS config for Private deployment.
  - ETA / Next milestone: Canary rollout to 10% traffic by 2026-07-14 if KV issue mitigated.

- FinNova (low-latency high-throughput) — Owner: Emily
  - Status: Dedicated capacity provisioned, workload profiling done. Batching config tuned vs baseline (30% cost improvement).
  - Blockers: Model quantization introduced a small BLEU/regression on structured outputs for one prompt set. Research suggested switching to hybrid quant profile; PR #214 on GitHub contains config.
  - Risk/Notes: Need stakeholder signoff on small quality regression before full traffic. Sales asked for strict SLOs in the next contract draft.
  - ETA / Next milestone: Final AB test results by 2026-07-10, decision by 2026-07-12.

- Eduly (pilot, embeddings + rerank) — Owner: Jordan
  - Status: Embeddings pipeline integrated. Indexing lambda scaled up. Rerank integration smoke tests passing locally.
  - Blockers: Customer provided data contains inconsistent UTF-8 sequences causing preprocess crashes in 2% of records. Team built a sanitizer but need customer to reexport or allow us to run a cleanup job.
  - Risk/Notes: Minimal product risk but timeline depends on customer data re-export.
  - ETA / Next milestone: Cleanup job scheduled for 2026-07-09 pending approval.

- RetailCo (enterprise rollout) — Owner: Priya
  - Status: Private deployment trial in customer VPC progressing. Networking team cleared initial VPN handshake; KMS integration in progress.
  - Blockers: On-prem infra team requested offline image for air-gapped install; release-engineering needs 3 business days to prepare.
  - Risk/Notes: Contract requires 99.95% availability; need to finalize HA plan and escalation paths with SRE.
  - ETA / Next milestone: Prepare offline bundle by 2026-07-10, HA plan review 2026-07-12.

Operational notes / serving-runtime updates:
- Runtime v1.14.2 rolled out to staging this week with kernel selection improvements for large-sequence attention. Observed ~8% lower p99 generation latency on internal benchmarks.
- Notable: the kernel change interacts poorly with older CUDA drivers in customer VPC images; release-eng to flag driver compatibility in offline bundles.

Open action items (owner — due date):
- Sam (SRE) — Complete trace and root cause for KV-cache eviction latency spikes (PROJ-8424) — due 2026-07-09.
- Miguel — Prepare canary rollout plan and rollback criteria for AcmeHealth — due 2026-07-12.
- Emily — Finalize AB test analysis and present recommendation for FinNova — due 2026-07-10.
- Jordan — Coordinate with Eduly to run data cleanup or provide export; document sanitizer steps — due 2026-07-09.
- Priya — Work with release-eng to request offline image build and validate KMS flow — due 2026-07-10.
- Aisha — Update runbook on Private deployment driver compatibility and share with release-eng — due 2026-07-08.

Blockers requiring escalation:
- KV-cache eviction pattern impacting AcmeHealth p99 latencies. If not resolved by 2026-07-09, escalate to Eng director and consider fallback to software K-V cache bypass for canary.
- BLEU/regression for FinNova quantization; product and research to decide on hybrid profile by 2026-07-12 or pause rollout.

Notes / Decisions:
- Agreed to run canary for AcmeHealth only after SRE signs off on KV mitigation.
- For FinNova, product will accept a short quality delta if cost wins are >20% and retraining is not required; final to be decided on AB results.

Miscellaneous:
- Lina (QA) is prepping a short test-suite focused on long-context streaming to capture the intermittent failures seen in AcmeHealth tests. ETA 2026-07-09.
- Solutions engineering to publish a short KB on sanitizing customer data exports (utf-8 issues) — Jordan + Aisha to draft.

Next meeting: 2026-07-14 10:00am PT
If anything urgent arises, ping #solutions-pro on Slack and tag leads.

Raw notes / quick scribbles from meeting (informal):
- "Acme p99 spike looks like eviction when autoscaler moves pods -> check sequence length distribution hitting different kernel path" — Miguel
- "FinNova likes the TCO numbers but hate the edge-case hallucination on structured forms" — Emily
- "Eduly can do reexport but need example script; we'll send them a small sanitizer" — Jordan
- "RetailCo legal asked about key rotation in air-gapped envs. Follow-up with security next week" — Priya

End of notes.
